messages:
emma: quick checkin on the priority-coalescer prototype results. ran 4h on canary pool. sharing quick notes.

emma: summary: short-request fastpath cut interactive p50 by ~11% and p90 by ~7%. p99 unchanged for most tenants, but one noisy tenant saw p99 +4% correlated with kv_evictions spike.

oliver: thanks. can you paste the fastpath decision sketch we used?

emma: decision = if sanitized_len_hint <= 64 && age < 8ms && budget < 40ms -> fastpath. missing hint => conservative (long). probe for streams uses first-3-token probe.

maya: noted misclass behavior? did we see many requeues?

emma: requeue rate ~0.5% overall. cost per requeue ~= 5ms + missed prefetch. roughly matches lab numbers.

liz: kv_evictions spike came during a 15m window where that tenant sent many long batched requests suddenly. their trust_score was high so fastpath accepted some borderline cases.

maya: trust_score tweak: lower acceptance threshold for tenants whose recent average len > 200. we already surface trust_score from sanitizer.

emma: agreed. also added infra alert: if kv_evictions_delta > 12% for 5m -> disable fastpath on that tenant group automatically.

ci-bot: perf-runner summary: 2026-03-23T11:04Z, suite priority-coalescer-canary, p50:-11%, p90:-7%, p99:+0.6% (global), kv_evictions:+9%

oliver: +9% kv_evictions is acceptable under AB criteria but we should tighten tenant-level rollbacks.

emma: plan: 1) apply trust_score threshold change (maya) 2) add tenant rollback hook on eviction alerts (liz) 3) run 48h A/B at 10% (oliver + ci).

maya: i'll send a sanitizer PR with the threshold logic and unit tests.

liz: i'll wire the rollback hook and dashboard panels.

emma: thanks all. if A/B looks stable we'll enable experiment flag for more customers next week.

oliver: nice work. small follow-up: capture microbatch sizes by priority so we can measure token-efficiency impact.

emma: adding that to dashboards.

ci-bot: perf-runner queued: priority-coalescer-ab-10pct

maya: :thumbsup:
